subject: Decision: depth+motion scope for the August LRB pre-read
body:
Team,

Decisions from the July 10 quality bar review, now that the follow-up runs are in:

1. AR occlusion ships on specified-intrinsics mode only. Learned intrinsics stays a research track -- the 1.4x convergence cost and the residual scale drift are not worth carrying into the SDK this half.
2. Katya's motion-field regularization is in: it cut dynamic-scene depth outliers by 23% on the harness metrics with no static-scene regression.
3. Leilani's evaluation harness becomes the gate for every checkpoint we promote; Giannis will wire it into the release pipeline by August 7.

LRB pre-read is August 12. I will circulate the narrative doc Friday.

Lucia
